A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same KROPE research work. Their complete main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–C are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C report original Garnet simulations, offline policy evaluation experiments on continuous-control domains, and representation stability analyses.

after.justification: V2 retains these original empirical results, including performance curves, divergence experiments, and Bellman-completeness measurements.

M1.justification: The KROPE kernel, representation learning loss, auxiliary-task procedure, and LSPE evaluation pipeline are unchanged in Section 3 and Appendix A.

E1.justification: Both versions use Garnet MDPs, four DM Control environments, nine D4RL-style datasets, and the same divergence scenario in Appendix C.3.1.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same FQE, ABS-DR3, BEER, and BCRL variants. The added discussion of Chen and Jiang does not introduce an evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C retain the same data generation, network settings, training budgets, error metrics, and evaluation procedures, including 500-epoch representation training.

E4.justification: The latent-dimension study, stability metrics, hyperparameter sensitivity, divergence analysis, Bellman-completeness analysis, and direct-FQE versus LSPE comparisons are all retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Both report 30 trials for Figure 2, 20 for most other results, and 10 for Figure 11, with the same 95% confidence-interval reporting. No statistical procedure changes are documented.

E6.justification: Figures 2–11 retain identical plotted results, and Tables 1–2 retain their numerical entries. The accompanying findings, including appendix divergence and Bellman-completeness results, are unchanged.

T1.justification: V2 repeats the existing dKROPE definition before Theorem 2 and moves its Appendix B.1 definition before Proposition 3. The formula already appears in v1; no mathematical definitions, assumptions, theorem statements, or proofs change in substance.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning KROPE's stability, Bellman completeness, and empirical evaluation accuracy.

C2.justification: The interpretations and limitations remain unchanged, including possible realizability loss, semi-gradient instability, dependence on sampled transition pairs, and unresolved differences between direct FQE and LSPE.

D1.justification: The pseudocode, implementation settings, hyperparameters, dataset-generation instructions, and access information in Appendices A and C are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 3.3 newly acknowledges Chen and Jiang (2019)'s similar Bellman-completeness result and distinguishes its bisimulation representations from KROPE's policy-specific representations. This work was already cited in v1; the bibliography is unchanged.

P1.justification: V2 adds a short prior-work explanation, states the existing distance definition before Theorem 2, and reorders its appendix introduction. Acknowledgements add Fanghui Liu and NSF support; the broader narrative remains intact.

P2.justification: The additional displayed definition and prose cause limited layout changes, including shifting Figure 4 downward and moving acknowledgements from page 10 to page 11. Figure designs, captions, and table structures are unchanged.

improvement.justification: V2 makes Theorem 2 easier to follow by supplying the previously appendix-only distance definition immediately beforehand, and introduces that definition before Proposition 3 in the appendix. Its explicit comparison with already cited prior work also improves attribution. These are limited clarity and positioning gains; the theoretical and empirical evidence remains unchanged.
